name: rpi-hat
summary: Raspberry Pi HAT: a 65 x 56.5 mm board that stacks on a Raspberry Pi's 40-pin GPIO header, with four M2.5 holes on the Pi's 58 x 49 mm pattern for 15-16 mm standoffs. For a board that is an add-on to a Raspberry Pi

cite.reading: Raspberry Pi HAT board mechanical drawing (hat-board-mechanical.pdf, p.1; its text layer is empty). The drawing is dimensioned from the bottom-left corner, y up; converted to top-left, y down for a 56.5 mm board. 65 x 56.5 mm with an SMT GPIO header (56.0 mm with a through-hole one), 3 mm corner radius (not modelled: the outline is rectangular)

Raspberry Pi HAT board mechanical drawing (hat-board-mechanical.pdf, p.1; its text layer is empty). The drawing is dimensioned from the bottom-left corner, y up; converted to top-left, y down for a 56.5 mm board. Holes 3.5 mm in from the left and bottom edges on a 58 x 49 mm pattern: drawing (3.5, 52.5); drill 2.75 +/-0.05 mm, non-plated preferred, >= 6.2 mm land (the footprint is 2.7 mm NPTH, 5.9 mm courtyard, plus the placer's clearance)
